description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects shell metacharacters in the tracer-behavior jid query argument.
affected_versions: Fortinet FortiSandbox: 4.4.0 through 4.4.8; Fortinet FortiSandbox PaaS: 23.4.4374, 23.4.4350, 23.3.4329, 23.1.4245, 22.2.4151, 22.2.4134, 22.1.4113, 21.4.4072, 21.3.4055; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects shell metacharacters in the tracer-behavior jid query argument.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate jid values containing shell punctuation are blocked.
